rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for the organ in the mouth.

example.english: Stick your tongue out for me to have a look.
example.traditional: 你伸條舌頭出嚟畀我睇吓。
example.jyutping: nei5 san1 tiu4 sit6 tau4 ceot1 lei4 bei2 ngo5 tai2 haa5

rows.note: Use this for a language, especially when contrasting different languages or referring to a native language.

example.english: I can speak more than one tongue, including Cantonese.
example.traditional: 我識講幾種語言，包括廣東話。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sik1 gong2 gei2 zung2 jyu5 jin4 baau1 kut3 gwong2 dung1 waa2

rows.note: Use this for someone's tone or habitual manner of speaking rather than for a language itself.

example.english: You have a sharp tongue when you're angry.
example.jyutping: nei5 nau1 go2 zan6 jyu5 hei3 hou2 zim1 jeoi6

rows.note: Use this specifically for tongue as animal meat or food.

example.english: This braised beef tongue is really tender.
example.jyutping: ni1 dip6 ngau4 lei6 man1 dak1 hou2 nam4
